meaning: Conditional refutation of the inertial rival STMT-INERTIAL-UNIFORM-MOTION-WITHOUT-MOVER. A body moved uniformly in a straight line with nothing moving it perseveres in that motion (STMT-MOVERLESS-UNIFORM-MOTION-IS-PERSEVERANCE), and on the state reading a body persevering in uniform rectilinear motion is not thereby being moved in that respect (STMT-UNIFORM-PERSEVERANCE-IS-NOT-BEING-MOVED); so no such body is being moved, against the rival. The rival therefore needs the becoming reading of DISAMB-UNIFORM-MOTION-STATE-OR-BECOMING, or must deny that a moverless uniformly moving body perseveres. Each premise is needed (STMT-RIVAL-REFUTATIONS-ROUND2-CONTROLS). It does not decide between the state and becoming readings, and both premises are open, so the refutation does not count for closure.
